intro: Calculate all Bonus Cards before the Agekeeper deals any. Each Harvest Source scores its single highest-matching Aspect.

steps.label: Base Harvest
steps.body: All players begin with 3 Kismeta Cards. This is always granted regardless of Alignment.

steps.label: Calculate Bonus Cards
steps.body: Each player tallies bonus cards from all applicable Harvest Sources: Zodiac Die, Astral Houses, Adept Cards, and Spread Cards. Each source scores its single highest-matching Aspect — Sign (+3), Planet (+2), Element (+1). Spread Cards: check each card against Cosmic Age Aspects (Planet and Suit/Element) for its highest match.

steps.label: Agekeeper's Boon
steps.body: If the Agekeeper's rolled Sign exactly matches the Cosmic Age Sign, add +2 cards to every player's tally.

steps.label: Deal the Harvest
steps.body: The Agekeeper deals each player their full Harvest total face-down, one at a time. (Base + Bonus + Agekeeper's Boon, if triggered.)
